import json, math
from fractions import Fraction as F

x, y, z = -3, 2, 5
rho2 = x*x + y*y          # 13
r = math.sqrt(rho2 + z*z)
theta = math.atan2(y, x)
phi = math.acos(z / r)

# numeric check via spherical formulas with phi - pi/2
p2 = phi - math.pi/2
nx = r*math.sin(p2)*math.cos(theta)
ny = r*math.sin(p2)*math.sin(theta)
nz = r*math.cos(p2)

# exact form: coordinates as coefficient * sqrt(13)
cx = F(-z*x, rho2)   # coefficient of sqrt(13)
cy = F(-z*y, rho2)
cz = F(1)

s13 = math.sqrt(rho2)
assert abs(nx - float(cx)*s13) < 1e-9
assert abs(ny - float(cy)*s13) < 1e-9
assert abs(nz - float(cz)*s13) < 1e-9

final = f"({cx}*sqrt(13), {cy}*sqrt(13), {cz}*sqrt(13)) = (15/sqrt(13), -10/sqrt(13), sqrt(13))"
print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": final,
    "evidence": {"r": r, "theta": theta, "phi": phi,
                 "numeric": [nx, ny, nz]}
}))
